ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface, with high-contrast low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the trailing edge perimeter and central vertical axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone. Continuous black band along the trailing edge boundary. Distinct vertical black segmented column at the base. Single isolated high-contrast black circular spot located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe. Dense black mottling at both lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 45-55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical extent of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits more pronounced pixel-amplitude variations and jaggedness compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature from the median notch extending laterally, followed by a sharp upward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, low-depth pockmarks (shadow/highlight clusters) distributed across the ventral lobes. One prominent high-contrast black circular spot on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial-lower portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch at the distal tip of the right lobe. Pitted surface texture throughout the white pigmentation area consistent with historical barnacle colonization sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique segmented vertical black pigmentation pattern resembling a ladder or series of rungs at the central base where the fluke meets the peduncle.
